meta.name: Unique Gasp

timing.walk: loop by distance: ph = floor(yards_walked * 3) % 8 (fps given at base speed 1.5 yd/s)
timing.wind: the wind-up's progress over 0.9 s in 3 steps (then holds)
timing.atk: state recover, t < 0.35 s: ph = floor(t / 0.12) (3 frames, holds the last)
timing.hit: struck recoil: frame 0 for ~0.1 s, frame 1 to ~0.24 s (not while winding up or striking)
timing.death: corpse: sampled at 12 fps from the kill (fall, then the darkened body it lies as; the web keeps the last frame, darkens/sinks it and fades it out over 30 s)

meta.mirror: Frames are painted facing screen-right (face +1). The web mirrors for face -1 by flipping the image about the anchor: x -> -x (a frame at dx with width w is drawn at -(dx + w)).
meta.facing8: dir8(): moving -> the way it goes, striking/winding -> its target. Octants (iso screen): R, DR, DL, L -> front view (R/DR face +1, DL/L face -1); UL, UR -> back view (UL face -1, UR face +1); straight D/U keep the last mirror and use front/back.
meta.scale: Rendered at the desktop scale: 3 atlas px per world px (canvas RS 4 x the 0.75 world-scale creatures and heroes are drawn at). One yard (tile) = 108 x 54 px on the iso grid. Nearest-neighbour, as the web draws it; no downscale (the sprite art is painted at 1.5x-3x world grain; the web blits it at this size).
meta.anchor: Anchor (0,0) = the entity's world position projected by iso() (its ground point). (dx,dy) = offset from the anchor to the frame top-left. The web draws the ground shadow ellipse centred 2 world px (6 atlas px) below the anchor; shadows are NOT in the frames.
meta.not_exported: white hit-flash (fl/flf: the frame as a flat white silhouette), burrowed state (Vein-Worms are not drawn while under), quest-target uniques drawn x1.3 (m.qScale), corpse fade/sink after the last frame
